items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Eridanus fork of the shadcn base-rhea input, installed in place of it at components/ui/input.tsx. Focus and errors show on the border alone: no focus ring, a muted-foreground border on focus (3:1 or better against the field in both themes) and a solid destructive border when invalid. Same API as shadcn's.
